6045fc86b00e.sentence: Fields cover how providers differ, so none needs code of its own: no `--scope` means the authorization URL has no `scope`; `--client-auth basic` sends the client as HTTP Basic instead of in the body; `--api-header 'Name: value'` goes on every `sesame api` request (a `-H` of that name replaces it); `--site-name-field` names the token response's field that `sesame providers` shows as the site (Notion's `workspace_name`); `--refresh-url` sends refreshes to their own endpoint (Figma's `/v1/oauth/refresh`; without it, the token endpoint); `--code-seconds` says how long the authorization code lasts (Figma: 30), so login asks for the pasted address within that time and a refused exchange says the code most likely expired.
